title: Source, evidence and proposition are different truth layers
summary: A legally interesting pipeline retains documentary truth separately from semantic interpretation, legal authority/effect and operational policy projection. Ingesting a document does not by itself certify the document as authoritative.
invariants: Documentary truth records exact source bytes/content identity, provenance and source spans.
Semantic truth records proposed propositions, definitions, exceptions, ambiguity and challenge history.
Legal authority/effect records jurisdiction, hierarchy, commencement/effective time, conflicts and verified authority evidence.
Operational projection records the decision boundary without rewriting the source or interpretation history.
LLM assistance is candidate evidence/authoring material; model identity and reasoning provenance must not be treated as legal authority.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 owns structured legal-effect evaluation and the compiler/certification authority boundary; public legal API remains legal.effect/0.10.
Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
